info.title: CantoTrack API
info.summary: Tickets, their comments, files and hours, the clock, and how the work is planned.
info.description: Every request acts as one account, with exactly its rights, through the same rules as the web. The whole description, for people, is docs/API.md — and inside the application under API documentation.

get.description: As a download, with its own type.

delete.description: One you attached — anybody's, as an administrator.

204.description: Done; nothing to show for it.

post.description: With two-step sign-in on, the password alone is 403 with details.two_factor_required; send the same request again with code. Wrong passwords and codes count towards the sign-in form's limit.

code.description: The two-step code, or a recovery code.

device.description: What the token is named after on the profile.

patch.description: Yours — anybody's, as an administrator. Only the fields sent change; billed hours are 422.

204.description: Done; nothing to show for it.

token.description: A personal access token (Profile → Access tokens), a service account's, or one from POST /auth/login.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a resend safe: the same key with the same request, from the same account within a day, gets the first answer again (with Idempotent-Replayed: true) and is not done again. 409 while the first is still being worked on; 422 for the same key with another request.

BadRequest.description: The body is not a JSON object, or a header is malformed.

Unauthorized.description: No token, or one that is unknown, expired, revoked, or whose account is switched off.

Forbidden.description: Not yours to do: a guest changing the work, somebody else's hours.

NotFound.description: Not there — or not somewhere you can see.

Conflict.description: Somebody else saved it first (see version) — or the same request is still being worked on.

TooLarge.description: More than the server takes in one go.

Unprocessable.description: Understood, but it does not make sense: no title, a day to come, a move the workflow does not allow.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many tries; wait for Retry-After seconds.

message.description: A sentence for a person, in the language of the account.

details.description: For a client to act on — two_factor_required, say.

service.description: A service account: a program's, not a person's.

category.description: What the column is: open work not started, work under way, or finished.

tickets.description: How many tickets it has, in the list.

resolution.description: Why a finished ticket is finished.

parent.description: The key of the ticket this is a subtask of.

version.description: Send it back with a PATCH to make the change conditional.

fields.description: The project's own fields, by name; null where empty.

project.description: A project's code. Needed for a new ticket; ignored in a PATCH.

status.description: A column by its id or its name. In a PATCH, a move the workflow has to allow.

resolution.description: With a done status, or for a ticket that is done already.

assignee_id.description: null takes it off whoever has it. Not a service account.

parent.description: A ticket's key: makes this its subtask.

release.description: A release's name or id, one not out yet.

sprint.description: PATCH only: a sprint's id, or null for the backlog.

fields.description: The project's own fields, by name.

version.description: PATCH only: the version read. Somebody else's save in between is 409.

kind.description: Read from the ticket asked about.

category.description: What the column is: open work not started, work under way, or finished.

type.description: Its media type, as found by its content.

url.description: Where the file itself is: GET /attachments/{id}.

rounded.description: Only after logging or changing: the time was rounded up to the smallest slice.

time.description: A duration: "1h 30m", "90m", "1:30". Needed for a new entry.

date.description: Today when not given; never a day to come.

remaining.description: New entries only: what is left on the ticket now.

work_type.description: A work type's name or id.

seconds.description: How long it has run, by the server's clock.

shared.description: A board of several projects, not one project's own.

query.description: What it narrows its projects' tickets to, in the query language.

text.description: The bell's sentence, in the account's language.
